title: Coin Change II
summary: Count the different multisets of coins with the given total.

contractDetails.constraints: 0 ≤ amount ≤ 5000. There are 1–300 distinct denominations in [1,5000]. The final count fits a signed 32-bit integer.

statement: Count the different multisets of coins with the given total. Each denomination can be used any number of times. Rearranging the same coins does not create another combination.

examples.explanation: Use four 1s, two 1s and a 2, or two 2s.
No selection of even coins makes an odd total.

constraints: 0 ≤ amount ≤ 5000. There are 1–300 distinct denominations in [1,5000]. The final count fits a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: Conceptual: Using no coins is one way to make zero.
Directional: Process one denomination at a time to avoid counting permutations.
Implementation: For each denomination, scan totals upward so that a state may reuse that denomination.
complexityAnalysis: O(amount × number of denominations) time and O(amount) space.
